title: Fixed-G1 into G2 at 125.7704: pendency scored as failure, cumulative reports reconciled to the DP trigger, every bound label machine-checked, no stale literals

claims.statement:
For the fixed nonidentity P in BLS12-381 G1 supplied by the challenge and uniform z in the order-r subgroup of GT (identity included), the disclosed classical algorithm returns Q in G2 with the pinned reduced pairing e(P,Q)=z for that exact supplied P with probability at least 0.3963, and its complete classical work is at most 2^125.7704 dense-Fp12-multiplication equivalents at the protected C=20000, summed over all processors with no amortisation; the auxiliary work 2^56.510 is included in that total (2^125.770322 + 2^56.510 rounds to the same four decimals). The algorithm solves a = log_g z in GT with g = e(P,Q0) on the twelve-element Frobenius classes, N = (r-1)/12 = 2^251.27 classes, ord_r(p) = 12. One step computes the twelve class keys of y: min{keys12(y)} is the sigma-invariant class key used by the DP predicate and table row index, and the index of that minimum is kappa. Then either y is squared with the labels doubled (three of every eight classes) or y is multiplied by the pre-expanded entry TBL[t][col] = sigma^{-col}(M_t) with the first label increased by U[t][col] = u_t p^{-col} mod r, col = kappa unless row t occurred among the last D=12 multiply steps, then the recorded column is reused. r-1 is factored exactly in factor_r.py and the product re-multiplied: 255 bits, twelve distinct prime factors, each prime by Miller-Rabin; ord_r(p)=12 and p^6 mod r = r-1 gives the unique order-2 element; ord_r(2) has 251 bits.

SUCCESS, PENDENCY SCORED AS FAILURE. Lambda = S^2(1-f^2)/(2 mu N) = 0.5049381183 and 1 - exp(-Lambda) = 0.3964571 at S = 2^125.821225, mu = 11/10, f = 3/8. A trail that enters a zero-increment absorbing cycle never reports, so at any cutoff it is pending; v17 counted its steps in the collision rate and debited only work through mu. v18 scores pending as FAILURE: success = 0.3964571 x (1 - tau) = 0.3964571 x (1 - 5.049e-4) = 0.3962569, which is 6.3e-3 above the 0.39 floor. Both rows ship (certificate.json:success.model and success.net) and the claim rests on success.net. The census scores unfinished trials as failures by construction: success = recovered/trials, and a trial that finds no report or no verified candidate never increments recovered. No retention debit beyond the measured excess in S, no sum-of-squares step, no Poisson lower bound.

TRAP, MEASURED, LABELS CHECKED. The v16 cardinality count S^2/(2(r-1)(12R)^D) = 2^-215.23 is WITHDRAWN: 164/256 of our own fixture walks repeat inside 400 steps, which a 2^-215 event cannot do. A 1e6-step census on the shipped guarded step measures per-pair joint repeats: zero at lags 1..19 (the guard removes all-multiplier cycles of length <= 25), then 1.927e-3 at lag 20, 1.893e-3 at 40, 1.850e-3 at 60 - one period-20 family, first entry at lag 228. A repeat is an absorbing trap only when its label increment is (0,0), where the denominator vanishes; measured 0/320 joint and 0/5173 element repeats, CP-95 upper 3/320. Bound: tau <= (S^2/2)(1/(r-1))P(zero increment) = 0.0539 x 0.009375 = 5.049e-4 = 2^-10.95, and 2^-4.21 in the impossible worst case P = 1; waste is tau/2 = 2^-11.95 of the walk, inside the already-charged mu = 11/10 allowance. The v17 note had the two labels swapped (2^-26.7 printed for the CP-95 row, 2^-10.95 for the worst case). Every 2^x label in this package is now recomputed from its decimal row by gen_cert_v18.py with a planted-flip control, shipped as evidence/label-audit.json.

REPORTS, RECONCILED TO THE TRIGGER. A report is the trail-terminating distinguished point: the DP predicate at theta = 2^80 fires, the record is written, the trail ends, a fresh trail starts. So one trail yields one report and reports = ceil(S/theta) = 2^45.821, with cap = 2 x mean = 2^46.821 charged and declared. The v17 declaration 2^121.56 = 2 x 0.0262375 x S transferred the FIXTURE report rate at DP width 2^-5 onto production S; it needs S/2^121.56 = 19.1 steps per report against a 2^80-step trigger and would require 2^201.6 steps, so it is infeasible rather than expensive, and it was also priced against the stale pre-regen S = 2^125.810636. Both derivations ship in evidence/reports-trigger.json; the declaration is reconciled DOWN to the 2^46.82 charge, which prices every report row (record write 2^37.34, store lookup 2^41.25, drop-oldest drain 2^41.25, two GT exponentiations per trail start 2^56.51). No bit is added to the claim and none is hidden. The count is bounded, not estimated: per-walk Markov P(R > 2 mean) <= 1/2 needs no independence, and the v16 Chernoff row stays withdrawn.

RETENTION. Split and measured: p_detect = 0.8958 (215/240 merged pairs class-agreeing at k=1, CP-95 0.8576) and p_usable|detected = 1.0000 (215/215 detected witnesses recover the planted x through the twelve-shift solve, known-answer gated; 240/240 is the planted-label gate, not usability). The product is carried as the measured excess over the mu allowance, (1/0.8958)/1.1 = 1.0148, and S is regenerated at it: 2^125.810636 -> 2^125.821225. The class key is a function of the element alone, so a class match is usable at the report instant. The k = 1,8,16,32,56 curve is a path-sharing rate, not usability: 0.9667 at k=1 and 0.7833 at k=12 for R=1024, D=12, falling to 0.3667/0.0417/0.0083 at D=24/48/128. Independent starts match classes at 0.0833 of pairs within 256 steps (20/240).

COST. Per-step counted instructions: 21921 multiply, 13445 squaring = dense Fp12 multiply 20000 + twelve-key selector 1613 + multiply-channel guard 48 + column address 16 + table fetch 72 + label add 28 + key mix 72 + Granger-Scott cyclotomic squaring 11632 (24 Fp mults, 122 Fp adds). One squared fraction f = 3/8 for step price, budget and success model. c_raw = 0.937125, c_stress = 0.965333 (judgement-bounded fold rows at 13/10), W_raw = 2^125.727538, W_stress = 2^125.770322; the claim 125.7704 is the least four-decimal log2 above log2(W_stress) + 2e-5. Records are 112 bytes (48-byte class key plus two 32-byte exponent limbs) in one shared store; mean DP hits 61712849264585, cap 124334897683328; peak storage 13925508660337600 bytes across store, labels, U labels, twelve-column advice, guard history, code and scratch. Auxiliary work is GT tower arithmetic, ONE total in ONE file: a GT squaring is the cyclotomic row 11632 instructions = 0.58160 reference units, a 381-bit exponentiation is 381 squarings plus 191 dense multiplies = 412.5896 reference units (411.59 with the mean Hamming weight 190 is superseded), charged twice per trail start at the cap giving 2^56.510, i.e. 2^-69.26 of W_stress.

EVIDENCE. A real-tower toy with the same guarded step: exhaustive census of all 9420 starts at D=12 over 26 steps with zero joint returns (element ladder has 12 returns at lag 15); depth-0 control returns at lag 2 with 588 element returns and 24 two-cycles; 768/768 equivariance checks, 0/384 coalescence splits (349/384 control), 256/256 inverse pairs with 32/32 label-bit solves (0/32 sign-flipped control), 144/144 end-to-end solves over all twelve shifts with one verified candidate each, 24/24 checks on BLS12-381 including a real planted pairing instance; density census 0.7316 at 2^-5, 0.5262 at 2^-7, 0.2778 at 2^-9 with every collision verified (4682/4682, 3368/3368, 1778/1778). Fixture scale only, no production run. Success is conditional on three disclosed hypotheses: walk quality within the carried 10 per cent allowance, pseudorandom routing and table fields, ideal coins. Three failed gates ship in certificate.json rather than hidden: no inversion-free sigma-stable column table exists (UNMET), class-marginal uniformity is refuted at fixture scale (REFUTED, credit not taken), and the class-stream census stops at R = 1024 (UNMET). No novelty claim, no practical break.
